messages:
alex: Quick sync — docs PR #432 is blocking the SDK snippet migration. Need a decision: compact code-first examples or expanded prose-first examples? cc @mira @jon

mira: For onboarding new devs: start with a tiny runnable snippet, then a short 'what happened' paragraph. :+1:

jon: Agree on tiny runnable. For the SDK we should show both sync+async call patterns. People search for examples not prose.

sam: we also need a migration note: old param 'model_name' -> 'model' and warn about casing. I'll draft.

taylor: Minor: glossary question — do we standardize on 'model variant' or 'model variant id'? This changes a couple of UI strings.

alex: Prefer 'model variant' in docs copy, 'variant_id' only in code/SDK params. Docs should map UX terms -> param names.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://git.redwood/ry/docs/pull/432 — title: 'sdk-snippet-migration: compact vs clarity samples'

mira: If we pick compact, include an expandable 'show full example' block in docs. Many pages support that pattern.

jon: Also add a one-line 'migration' table at top of each SDK doc: old -> new. Eg: | old | new | notes |

sam: I'll add that table in a separate PR and link from 432. ETA today EOD.

taylor: I'll update glossary entries and leave a comment in the PR with canonical phrasing.

alex: Decision for this thread: examples = code-first tiny snippet + short paragraph + optional expanded sample. Glossary: 'model variant' for UX, 'variant_id' for SDK. Migration table required. Action owners: sam (migration table), taylor (glossary), mira (examples pattern), jon (async sample). I'll merge once PR 432 has those.

mira: :thumbsup: I'll add the expandable sample pattern and a 2-line rationale.

jon: Will add async+sync snippets and a tiny note about token usage.

sam: PR 433 opened with migration table: https://git.redwood/ry/docs/pull/433

taylor: Glossary updates pushed to branch gloss/variant-naming. Left inline comments on PR 432.

alex: Thanks all. I'll wait for CI + one approver, then merge. If anyone hits a blocker ping me.
